etapa3_muslr_logicam.afirmacao: The main subject of the image is in front of the background.
etapa3_muslr_logicam.raciocinio:
(1) Relevant premises selected:

- pedestrian on crosswalk line  
- background vehicles behind pedestrian  
- center high-rise building behind parking sign  
- left office building behind white sedan  
- right buildings behind red SUV  
- sky above buildings  

From the image, the visually central/main subject is the pedestrian crossing the road.

(2) Reasoning type:

Spatial relation reasoning, specifically depth/front-background reasoning.

(3) Formal logical application:

Let:

- Main subject = pedestrian
- Background = background vehicles/buildings/sky region

Premise:

$$
\text{behind}(\text{background vehicles}, \text{pedestrian})
$$

The spatial inverse rule is:

$$
\text{behind}(A, B) \Rightarrow \text{in\_front\_of}(B, A)
$$

Apply the rule:

$$
\text{behind}(\text{background vehicles}, \text{pedestrian})
\Rightarrow
\text{in\_front\_of}(\text{pedestrian}, \text{background vehicles})
$$

Since the pedestrian is the main subject, we conclude:

$$
\text{in\_front\_of}(\text{main subject}, \text{background})
$$

The statement is valid.

FINAL ANSWER: True
